description: RED-TEAM robustness audit of the A=3 magnitude target μ₃≈+0.4708 (numerator of r*=μ₃/c₃≈1.585). μ₃ = ρ_strong(3) − ρ_grad(3) = B(³H)/B(²H) − [3]_q is a ~12% residual of two O(3.4) numbers (condition number ≈8), and μ₃ = M(3) EXACTLY (unit-triangular 3×3 solve, μ₂=0 forced) — NOT a statistical moment, so there is no raw/Richardson/cumulant method freedom. FINDINGS after fairness checks: (a) within the isospin-corrected-strong isotope family μ₃ is stable ±~8% (0.445–0.509 ⇒ r*∈[1.50,1.71]); it only collapses to 0.127 under the physically-inconsistent raw-³He (no-Coulomb) choice, which is not defensible. (b) the q-integer convention is PINNED: ρ_grad=[A]_q! is the coinvariant graded dimension ⇒ Gaussian/unbalanced is forced by Chevalley, so the 1.63× balanced swing is NOT a legitimate re-choice; the q₀ pin (muon vs proton) is not a lever (identical to 7sf, swing 1.0000001x). (c) sign(μ₃)=+/sign(μ₄)=− are corpus-PROVED robust (#4300 / DampingNonMonotoneWall — holds raw+corrected, non-monotone ⇒ not a damping). VERDICT scope-(a): μ₃ is NOT a decomposition artifact — its sign, ≥3-body purity, and O(1.6) magnitude are well-posed structural facts and the cross-channel hunt is JUSTIFIED. What is NOT well-posed is the 3-sig-fig VALUE 0.4708 / r*=1.585: a condition-number-8 residual with an irreducible ±8% isospin-correction band, honest target r*≈1.6±0.1. Siblings should score by sign + landing in [1.50,1.71], NOT by matching 1.585 to 3 sf (that would over-fit the isospin convention). Nothing wired.

axis_c_moment_method.reason: 3 isotopes (A=2,3,4) pin 3 coefficients via unit-triangular counts matrix det=1 ⇒ EXACT invertible relabel, not a fit/moment. No residual, no over-determination, no method freedom.

cancellation_structure.note: μ₃ is a ~12% residual of two O(3.4) numbers ⇒ a catastrophic-cancellation object: small absolute perturbations to EITHER operand move μ₃ by a large RELATIVE amount (condition number ≈ 8.099).

verdict.classification: scope-(a) WELL-POSED-AT-~10%%, NOT-3-SIG-FIG. After the fairness checks, μ₃ is NOT a free-floating decomposition artifact: (i) its SIGN (+) is corpus-PROVED robust — it holds for BOTH raw and isospin-corrected AME, and the required correction is non-monotone so it cannot be a damping (#4300 / DampingNonMonotoneWall); (ii) the subtracted ladder's q-integer convention is PINNED (coinvariant graded dimension ⇒ Gaussian/unbalanced, not free); (iii) the q₀ pin (muon vs proton) is not a lever (identical to 7 sf; swing 1.0000001x -- and that is measured against the REAL proton pin, where the superseded 1.10997859 literal gave 1.00000004x); (iv) within the isospin-corrected-strong isotope family μ₃ varies only ~±8% (0.445–0.509 ⇒ r* ∈ [1.50,1.71]). What is NOT well-posed is the 3-sig-fig VALUE: μ₃ is a condition-number-≈8 residual (12% of two O(3.4) operands), so the ±8% isospin-correction band is irreducible and 0.4708 over-states precision — the honest target is r* ≈ 1.6 ± ~0.1.
verdict.what_IS_robust: μ₂ = 0 (FORCED, deuteron self-reference, Lean-proved); sign(μ₃)=+ and sign(μ₄)=− (corpus-proved, raw+corrected); the ≥3-body purity; the unbalanced graded-dimension convention; order-of-magnitude μ₃ ≈ 0.47 ± 0.04.
verdict.what_is_soft: the 3-sig-fig value 0.4708 and hence r*=1.585 to 4 sf — a condition-number-8 residual with an irreducible ~±8% isospin-correction band; NOT a high-precision (sub-%) target and never will be.
verdict.advice_to_siblings: The cross-channel hunt IS justified — the target (sign + O(1.6) magnitude) is a real structural fact, not an artifact. BUT: score a derived c₃ by SIGN and by landing r* within the [1.50,1.71] band (~±8%), NOT by matching 1.585 to 3 sig figs. A mechanism tuned to reproduce 1.585 exactly would be over-fitting the isospin-correction convention inside a 12%-residual — the residual simply cannot carry 3 sig figs of meaning.

q0AnchorReason: Axis (b) of this red-team audit IS the q0 pin swing: rho_grad3 and mu3 are evaluated at BOTH the ideal-CAL-2 (muon) and experimental (proton) pins and their ratio is published as axis_b_q0_pin_muon_vs_proton_swing_LIVE. Both legs are read by name -- muon from q_parameter.q_muon_at(70), proton from q_parameter.Q_50_DIGIT_STR. This is a comparison, not a layer straddle (bean qou-9ugp).
